# Mandarin Fireworks

> > Mandarin Fireworks - Professional pyrotechnics manufacturer from Liuyang, China, specializing in consumer and professional display fireworks for celebrations worldwide.

Mandarin Fireworks offers a comprehensive range of pyrotechnic products including cake fireworks, roman candles, fountains, display shells, and novelty items. Products are available in both 1.3G (UN0335) professional and 1.4G (UN0336) consumer classifications with customizable effects for festivals and celebrations.

## Key Topics

- Cake Fireworks
- Professional Fireworks Display (1.3G UN0335)
- Consumer Fireworks (1.4G UN0336)
- Liuyang Manufacturing
- Customizable Effects
- Roman Candle Fireworks
- Fountain Fireworks
- Display Shell Fireworks
- Pyrotechnics
- Festival & Celebration Fireworks
- 100-Shot Cakes
- Wholesale Fireworks
- Chinese Pyrotechnics
- Toy Fireworks
- Stage & Party Effects
